caption: *The product and its supporting apparatus.* Production and apparatus composition at ten sampled revisions. The support ratio is apparatus divided by production: about 2.6× at week 11, 3.6× at week 21, and 3.8× at week 31. Lines between samples interpolate; they are not additional measurements. The apparatus’s size establishes investment, not its return. [short: Product and supporting apparatus]
